text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, with the spring Tenno Sho drawing close, Biwa Hayahide shows up looking especially exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, her sister, has recently won the Satsuki Sho and set a new track record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the remarkable feat has dealt a spectacular blow to Biwa Hayahide, casting a shadow of doubt over her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin confesses to Biwa Hayahide that she's always thought of her as a "real pain in the butt."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though her attempt to bring comfort is awkward at best, it's Narita Taishin's best effort to encourage her friend and rival.
